About MN Carpenters

Woodwork Built on
Trust & Skill

MN Carpenters is a family-run carpentry workshop in Ballary, Karnataka. For over 18 years, our master craftsmen have turned quality timber into beautiful, lasting furniture and interiors for hundreds of homes and offices.

Every joint is cut with care, every surface sanded smooth, and every piece delivered with pride. We work across Ballary, Hospet, Sandur and surrounding areas.

  • Licensed & experienced carpentry team in Ballary
  • Premium teak, sheesham & engineered wood
  • Free on-site measurements & design consultation
  • Serving Ballary, Hospet, Sandur & beyond
  • 5-year warranty on all installations

What We Build

Carpentry Services in Ballary

From a single wardrobe to a complete home interior — MN Carpenters designs, crafts, and installs woodwork that fits your life.

Custom Furniture

Sofas, dining tables, beds, wardrobes, and showcase units crafted to your exact dimensions and style preference.

Modular Kitchens

Complete modular kitchen design and installation — cabinets, shutters, lofts & countertops in any finish.

Bedroom Interiors

Complete bedroom woodwork — beds with storage, study units, TV panels, and full wardrobe systems.

Office Furniture

Executive desks, reception counters, office cabinets, and conference tables for businesses in Ballary.

Repairs & Polishing

Restoration, varnishing, wood polishing, and hinge or lock replacement for your existing furniture.
